subject.title: fix(cli): bound --message-file reads for agent command

question: Should `openclaw agent --message-file` adopt the proposed unconditional 4 MiB maximum, or should this hardening use another established input ceiling?
rationale: Bounding the read is necessary, but the exact maximum is a new public CLI compatibility contract not established by current docs, tests, or the original feature discussion.

options.title: Approve 4 MiB
options.body: Land this narrow behavior-preserving hardening patch with 4 MiB as the supported file-input ceiling.

options.title: Select Another Ceiling
options.body: Choose an existing prompt or request-size contract and update the constant, regression assertion, and real CLI proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Approve 4 MiB
recommendation.body: Land this narrow behavior-preserving hardening patch with 4 MiB as the supported file-input ceiling.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original public message-file feature and is the strongest available maintainer-side owner for confirming its compatibility boundary.
